description: This file defines the authentication API routes for a FastAPI-based backend, including user registration (/register), login (/login), and user profile retrieval (/me). It handles dependencies, logging, error handling, and interaction with an authentication service and database repositories.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to register authentication endpoints.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing user info returned by API.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing JWT token response.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for login request payload.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, handling validation, exceptions, and invoking auth service.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, validates credentials, returns JWT token.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves current user profile based on authentication token.
